scope: 16-environment CUDA physics and independent CUDA diagnostic recomputation

metric_definitions.sampling: post-physics, pre-auto-reset; one sample per 0.02-second control step, including terminal step
metric_definitions.heading_rms_rad: sqrt(mean(wrapped world yaw^2)); world +X is zero heading
metric_definitions.heading_max_abs_rad: max(abs(wrapped world yaw)) over post-physics samples
metric_definitions.actual_joint_acceleration_rms_rad_s2: sqrt(mean_time_and_8_joints(((actual_joint_velocity[t]-actual_joint_velocity[t-1])/control_dt)^2)); first sample uses known reset velocity; 50Hz finite difference, not 500Hz acceleration peaks
metric_definitions.excluded: reset jumps, physics-step acceleration peaks, mechanical power and raw actor action clipping
